list.text: \f[facemagma]\bCom esse plano, finalmente o grande Pokémon aparecerá...
\f[facemagma]\bEu não sei quem você é, mas se entrar no caminho do Time Magma, não espere nenhuma gentileza!
\f[facemagma]\bButler, o Grande Mordomo, você está conosco, ou não?!
\f[faceButler]\bEu os conheço, não façam nada a eles.
\f[facemagma]\bNós já temos o que queremos, não precisamos ficar aqui.

then.text: \f[faceButler]\bOlá \PN e \v[77], espero que eles não tenham lhes causado maiores problemas.

\f[faceButler]\bNão tenho nenhum envolvimento com eles, se foi isso que pareceu...
\f[faceButler]\bNão temos idéia do que eles podem estar planejando.

list.text: \f[faceMagmaAdmin]\bThen all that's left is to wait.
\f[faceMagmaAdmin]\b...our leader's wish will finally be granted.
\f[facemagma]\bI don't know who you are, but if you get in Team Magma's way, don't expect any kindness!
\f[facemagma]\bThe Great Butler! What are you doing here?
\f[faceButler]\bI know these kids, don't do anything to them.
\f[faceMagmaAdmin]\bWe already have what we want, we don't need to stay here.
\f[faceMagmaAdmin]\bThat's it! See you around Great Butler!

then.text: \f[faceButler]\bHi \PN and \v[77], I hope they haven't caused you any major problems.

else.text: \f[faceButler]\bHi \PN and \v[76], I hope they haven't caused you any major problems.

list.text: \f[faceButler]\bTeam Magma is a dangerous group of fanatics.
\f[faceButler]\bThey have already caused a lot of problems, claiming that they are going to increase the Earth's mass.
\f[faceButler]\bTeam Magma is quite dangerous, so please stay away from them.
\f[faceButler]\bAs the time for the Millennium Comet to appear draws near, many bad people, who wish to use its wish-granting power for insane ends can appear...
\f[faceButler]\bSo, be very careful...\nNo one knows you have the Whishing Star, and we should keep that our secret, for your own safety.

then.text: \f[faceDiane]\r\PN, \v[77], there's still some time until the Millennium Comet appears, why don't you go to the Double Battle Tournament in Fallarbor Town in the meantime?

else.text: \f[faceDiane]\r\PN, \v[76], there's still some time until the Millennium Comet appears, why don't you go to the Double Battle Tournament in Fallarbor Town in the meantime?

then.text: \f[face_namo_boy]\bAbsol was trying to show us Team Magma's plans...
\f[face_namo_boy]\bIt's trying to protect Jirachi, I can say that for sure.
\f[face_namo_boy]\bI'm glad we're together, so we can keep Jirachi safe until the Millennium Comet appears.
